card.text: Small moon that leads Tethys along its orbit around Saturn.

introduction.text: Telesto has a smooth, icy surface without the heavy cratering seen on many of Saturn's moons.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain in cast shadows is left empty.
